title: The library
content: I’m very curious to know if anyone dreams of a large library with rooms full of rare books… not rare enough that you have to wear gloves, but they seem very important. As with any library, the books are arranged in some kind of topical order, and I go from room to room to room looking for answers — to what, I don’t remember. I’ve had this dream a few times that I know of. I don’t recall many details, but here are the things I do remember: Large illustrated books of animals in an Audubon style Many, many rooms that I have to weave in and out of A sense of familiarity that I have been there many times before The style of the building is like a really large Carnegie library (many Carnegie libraries were in small towns and had a classical, grand feel) Anyone?
